description: A calm and neutral life requires me to remain focused , intentional and flexible. #selflove #stewardship #selfpreservation
transcript: I live in a space of neutrality because it does not matter where the ball lands, it's still my court, my life belongs to me. It is my responsibility to lead with flexibility, it is my job to pull out my resources in order to make things work. However, the ball lands is how the ball lands. What matters is how I handle it.
